info.name: Dell Servers Dell OpenManage Enterprise API
Dell Servers Create an authentication session

items.docs: Authenticates with the OpenManage Enterprise console using username and password credentials. Returns a session token in the X-Auth-Token response header that must be included in all subsequent API requests.

params.name: $top
params.description: Maximum number of devices to return

params.name: $skip
params.description: Number of devices to skip for pagination

params.name: $filter
params.description: OData filter expression to narrow results. Common filters include Type eq 1000 for servers, Type eq 2000 for chassis.

params.name: $orderby
params.description: Property name to sort results by

items.docs: Retrieves the collection of devices managed by OpenManage Enterprise including servers, chassis, storage, and network devices. Supports OData query parameters for filtering, sorting, and pagination.

info.name: Dell Servers Get a managed device

params.name: DeviceId
params.description: Unique identifier for a managed device

items.docs: Retrieves detailed information about a specific managed device including hardware inventory, connection status, health, firmware versions, and assigned groups.

info.name: Dell Servers Get device inventory details

params.name: DeviceId
params.description: Unique identifier for a managed device

items.docs: Retrieves the detailed hardware inventory for a specific device including processor, memory, storage, network adapter, firmware, and software inventory components.

params.name: $filter
params.description: OData filter expression to narrow results

items.docs: Retrieves the collection of device groups configured in OpenManage Enterprise, including built-in system groups and user-created custom groups. Groups are used to organize devices for monitoring, reporting, and applying policies.

info.name: Dell Servers List devices in a group

params.name: GroupId
params.description: Unique identifier for a device group

items.docs: Retrieves the collection of devices that are members of the specified group. Supports OData query parameters for filtering and pagination.
Retrieves the collection of discovery configuration groups that define target ranges, protocols, and credentials used for device discovery.

info.name: Dell Servers Create a discovery configuration

items.docs: Creates a new discovery configuration group that defines network ranges, protocols, and credentials for discovering devices. When executed, the discovery job scans the specified ranges and adds discovered devices to the managed inventory.
Retrieves the collection of discovery job instances showing status, progress, and results for discovery operations.

params.name: $top
params.description: Maximum number of alerts to return

params.name: $skip
params.description: Number of alerts to skip for pagination

params.name: $filter
params.description: OData filter expression for alert criteria

params.name: $orderby
params.description: Property name to sort results by

items.docs: Retrieves the collection of alerts generated by managed devices. Alerts include hardware faults, threshold violations, configuration changes, and audit events. Supports OData filtering and pagination.
Retrieves detailed information about a specific alert including the source device, severity, category, message, and recommended actions.

params.name: $filter
params.description: OData filter expression for job criteria

items.docs: Retrieves the collection of jobs in OpenManage Enterprise including discovery, firmware update, configuration, and report jobs. Supports OData filtering by job type and status.
Creates a new job for executing operations such as firmware updates, configuration deployment, or inventory refresh on targeted devices.
Retrieves the status and details of a specific job including progress percentage, execution history, and any error messages.

Retrieves the collection of firmware catalogs registered in OpenManage Enterprise. Catalogs contain firmware packages from Dell support sites or custom repositories used for compliance checking and updates.

info.name: Dell Servers Get firmware compliance baselines

items.docs: Retrieves firmware compliance baselines that define the expected firmware versions for devices. Baselines are used to check device compliance and identify devices needing firmware updates.
Retrieves the collection of server configuration templates that define desired BIOS, RAID, network, and iDRAC settings. Templates can be deployed to one or more servers for consistent configuration.
Retrieves the collection of report definitions available in OpenManage Enterprise. Report definitions specify the query criteria, columns, and filters for generating reports on managed devices.

info.name: Dell Servers Get appliance network configuration

items.docs: Retrieves the network configuration of the OpenManage Enterprise appliance including IP address, subnet mask, gateway, DNS, and NTP settings.
